name: Graylog
description: Centralized log management platform for collecting, searching, and analyzing log data at scale.

envVars.description: At least 16 character secret used to secure stored passwords
SHA2 hash of the admin root password
External URI used by browsers and other Graylog nodes

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      GRAYLOG_MONGODB_URI: "mongodb://{{serviceName}}-mongo:27017/graylog"
      GRAYLOG_ELASTICSEARCH_HOSTS: "http://{{serviceName}}-opensearch:9200"
      GRAYLOG_PASSWORD_SECRET: {{env.GRAYLOG_PASSWORD_SECRET}}
      GRAYLOG_ROOT_PASSWORD_SHA2: {{env.GRAYLOG_ROOT_PASSWORD_SHA2}}
      GRAYLOG_HTTP_EXTERNAL_URI: {{env.GRAYLOG_HTTP_EXTERNAL_URI}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/usr/share/graylog/data
  {{serviceName}}-mongo:
    image: mongo:7
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mongo
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-opensearch:
    image: opensearchproject/opensearch:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-opensearch
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      discovery.type: single-node
      DISABLE_SECURITY_PLUGIN: true
      OPENSEARCH_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms1g -Xmx1g"
